subject.title: Dashboard: editable notes / todo / markdown widget (stateful)

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this as a bundled dashboard builtin after widget write-back lands, or should editable notes/todo live as an external dashboard plugin/ClawHub package first?
rationale: The code path is not present on main, and the choice crosses bundled UI scope, plugin distribution, and persistent widget-state policy that automation should not decide.

options.title: Keep As Bundled Dashboard Subitem
options.body: Keep this issue open and review it after the write-back dependency defines the approved state/storage contract.

options.title: Move To External Plugin First
options.body: Ask for a ClawHub or external plugin implementation if maintainers do not want optional notes/todo widgets bundled in core dashboard work yet.

options.title: Defer Until Dashboard Stack Lands
options.body: Leave this issue open but blocked until the Wave 1 dashboard PRs and the write-back issue are accepted or rejected.

recommendation.title: Keep As Bundled Dashboard Subitem
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and review it after the write-back dependency defines the approved state/storage contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged-history signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and the maintainer-side product/security boundary around bundled dashboard surfaces.
